result.summary: The main defect is the promo banner: its white headline and promo-code text sit on a very pale mint background and are nearly invisible. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between the two Popular cards.

issues.description: The promo banner's headline ('3 free deliveries for you') and subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are white on a very light mint background. Contrast is extremely low, so users can barely read the offer or the promo code they need to enter. Only the 'Order now' button stands out.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light background, or darken the banner to a saturated green so the white text reaches at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Consider making the promo code more prominent, e.g., bold or in a chip.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a dark circular backdrop that almost disappears into the dark image. On the pizza card below, the same backdrop is a clearly visible dark circle. The treatment looks inconsistent, and the ramen card's tap target is hard to make out.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent backdrop to the heart button on all cards, such as a semi-opaque white or dark circle with a subtle shadow, so it stays visible on any image.
